A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the dual tag system with an oxidizing environment is a good starting point for expressing membrane proteins in E.coli, but that further fine-tuning of the system will be necessary to achieve high yields.

the use of the maltose-binding protein/hexahistine tag system with E. coli is an effective method to express membrane proteins, but the use of a cysteine-free protein and/or a cysteine to serine mutation at a critical disulfide site may be required to obtain full-length protein.
